title: 原生进程实操：GCC、真实fork/exec/vfork/clone与等待证据
review_note: 原ID改编为真实GCC/系统调用/等待实操，所有vfork分支及变体均避免未定义行为，仅追踪自有子进程。
original_title: 以下系统调用之间有什么区别？: exec(), fork(), vfork() and clone()?
topic: 进程创建、替换与资源共享
body:
环境：非root Linux x86_64、GCC及Python标准库；内核允许追踪自有子进程。若ptrace不可用是环境不满足，不修改Yama、sysctl、权限、默认身份或宿主配置。

操作任务：实现demo.c，编译程序CLI为demo MODE EXEC_TARGET INITIAL；MODE是fork/exec/vfork/clone，INITIAL为-1000..1000的完整十进制整数且非空。无效模式/数字退出2且stdout为空。可信目标程序由检查器独立编译，接收origin=exec或vfork，输出实际pid/ppid并退出29。

fork：真实fork产生子PID，子把自己的原子整数INITIAL加17并通过pipe传回pid/ppid/value，退出23；父waitpid取得状态，自身值仍INITIAL。clone：glibc clone使用独立1MiB栈、CLONE_VM|SIGCHLD、不使用CLONE_THREAD；子通过原子操作加17并写pipe，退出31，父waitpid后值也为INITIAL+17。两模式stdout一行JSON精确含mode/pid/child/child_ppid/parent_value/child_value/waited_exit。

exec：当前进程直接execve可信EXEC_TARGET，参数origin=exec，不创建额外子进程；PID保持，目标退出29。vfork：在调用前准备argv，子分支严格只能execve预备的可信目标或在exec失败时_exit(127)，不能printf、改变量/堆栈数据、sleep、free或从调用函数返回。父在子exec/_exit前暂停，返回后waitpid，输出mode/pid/child/waited_exit；目标另输出自己的实际pid/ppid。不得用vfork共享内存写值来演示差异，避免未定义行为。

产物：demo.c；GCC实际生成临时二进制。代码可使用fork、execve、vfork、clone、pipe、原子整数和waitpid；不以手写PID/退出状态JSON代替真实过程。

验收方法：可信跟踪器只追踪自己创建的子进程树，记录内核clone/fork/vfork/exec事件、实际系统调用参数、wait4目标与真实退出状态；exec时读取/proc/PID/exe确认同PID替换，vfork在跟踪子进程尚未exec时记录父等待状态，验证VFORK_DONE及子首个系统调用为execve。随机化初值对照独立/共享内存；四路及不含UB的独立突变。注意glibc fork可由无CLONE_VM的内核clone实现，依据语义和实际flags判断，不强制fork内核号。

能力边界：仅Linux x86_64自有进程，未创建容器/线程服务或修改宿主策略；不表示任意vfork程序安全，不计原214独立故障。
真实状态观察合同：定义全局4字节_Atomic int opsforge_shared_value作为被修改的状态，父在创建前置为INITIAL。检查器对本题临时二进制用-fno-pie/-no-pie链接（不改宿主ASLR），通过ELF符号定位并只读ptrace实际父/子内存，在子退出前、父wait完成前检查真实独立/共享修改；不能只自报JSON数值。waitpid可等待明确child，也可等待任一子并核对返回的实际PID，验收以真实wait4返回获批child为准。
rubric: 核心概念与因果关系准确
前提、限制和验证方式与题意一致

exercise.environment: nonroot Linux x86_64, GCC, own-child ptrace and Python ctypes
exercise.operation: 实际实现并编译四种进程机制，用内核事件、共享/独立内存、exec PID和wait退出状态核证。
exercise.verification: 真实GCC/ptrace系统调用和/proc进程证据，vfork子仅execve/_exit，四路及独立安全突变。
exercise.pass_criteria: 所有实际进程/等待/内存及输入边界断言完成，平台completed/passed均true。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import json,os,pathlib,subprocess,sys,tempfile
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
from native_syscalls import compile_sources,trace,shared_value_address
root=pathlib.Path.cwd();uid=os.getuid()
scope=pathlib.Path('/proc/sys/kernel/yama/ptrace_scope')
before_scope=scope.read_bytes() if scope.exists() else None
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='process-syscall-build-',dir=root)as directory:
 demo,target=compile_sources(directory,root/'demo.c');target=str(target.resolve())
 address=shared_value_address(demo)
 summaries=[]
 for mode in ['fork','clone','exec','vfork']:
  for initial in ([-11,37] if mode in ('fork','clone') else [5]):
   report=trace(demo,[mode,target,str(initial)],memory_address=address if mode in ('fork','clone')else None)
   pid=report['root_pid'];events=report['events'];calls=report['syscalls'];exits=report['exits']
   assert report['stderr']=='',report['stderr']
   rows=[json.loads(line)for line in report['stdout'].splitlines()]
   assert rows and all(isinstance(row,dict)for row in rows),rows
   if mode in ('fork','clone'):
    assert len(rows)==1 and set(rows[0])=={'mode','pid','child','child_ppid','parent_value','child_value','waited_exit'},rows
    row=rows[0];child=row['child'];expected_exit=23 if mode=='fork'else 31
    assert row['mode']==mode and row['pid']==pid and row['child_ppid']==pid and child!=pid
    assert row['child_value']==initial+17
    assert row['parent_value']==(initial if mode=='fork'else initial+17)
    assert row['waited_exit']==expected_exit and exits[child]=={'exit_code':expected_exit} and exits[pid]=={'exit_code':0}
    native_creations=[call for call in calls if call['tid']==pid and call['number']in (56,57)]
    assert len(native_creations)==1,native_creations
    creation=native_creations[0]
    if mode=='clone':assert creation['number']==56 and creation['args'][0]&0x100,creation
    else:assert creation['number']==57 or not creation['args'][0]&0x100,creation
    assert any(event['tid']==pid and event.get('related_tid')==child and event['event']in (1,3) for event in events)
    assert any(call['tid']==pid and call['number']==61 and call['returned']==child for call in report['syscall_exits']),'waitpid did not return the approved child'
    memory=report['memory_samples']
    assert len(memory)==1 and memory[0]['parent']==pid and memory[0]['child']==child
    assert memory[0]['parent_before_creation']==initial and memory[0]['child_before_exit']==initial+17
    assert memory[0]['parent_after_child_before_reap']==(initial if mode=='fork'else initial+17),memory
    summaries.append({'mode':mode,'initial':initial,'root_pid':pid,'child_pid':child,'values':[row['parent_value'],row['child_value']],'native_memory':memory[0],'child_exit':expected_exit,'native_creation_number':creation['number'],'native_clone_flags':creation['args'][0]if creation['number']==56 else None,'native_wait4_returned_child':True})
   elif mode=='exec':
    assert len(rows)==1 and rows[0]['mode']=='target' and rows[0]['origin']=='exec' and rows[0]['pid']==pid,rows
    assert exits[pid]=={'exit_code':29}
    assert not any(event['event']in (1,2,3)for event in events),'exec incorrectly created a child'
    assert any(event['event']==4 and event['tid']==pid and event['exe']==target for event in events),'same PID executable replacement not observed'
    summaries.append({'mode':mode,'original_pid':pid,'target_pid':rows[0]['pid'],'same_pid_exec_event':True,'target_exit':29})
   else:
    parents=[row for row in rows if row.get('mode')=='vfork'];targets=[row for row in rows if row.get('mode')=='target']
    assert len(parents)==len(targets)==1 and len(rows)==2,rows
    row=parents[0];child=row['child']
    assert row['pid']==pid and row['waited_exit']==29 and targets[0]['pid']==child and targets[0]['ppid']==pid and targets[0]['origin']=='vfork'
    assert exits[pid]=={'exit_code':0} and exits[child]=={'exit_code':29}
    assert any(call['tid']==pid and call['number']==58 for call in calls),'real vfork syscall missing'
    assert any(event['event']==2 and event['tid']==pid and event['related_tid']==child for event in events)
    assert any(event['event']==5 and event['tid']==pid and event['related_tid']==child for event in events),'VFORK_DONE event missing'
    assert any(event['event']==4 and event['tid']==child and event['exe']==target for event in events),'vfork child did not exec target'
    child_entries=[call for call in calls if call['tid']==child]
    assert child_entries and child_entries[0]['number']==59,'vfork child made a forbidden pre-exec syscall'
    waiting=report['vfork_wait_observations']
    assert len(waiting)==1 and waiting[0]['parent']==pid and waiting[0]['child']==child
    parent_state=waiting[0]['parent_before_child_exec']
    assert parent_state and parent_state['state']in ('D','S') and parent_state['wchan']not in ('','0'),waiting
    assert pathlib.Path(waiting[0]['child_before_exec_exe'])==demo.resolve(),waiting
    assert any(call['tid']==pid and call['number']==61 and call['returned']==child for call in report['syscall_exits'])
    summaries.append({'mode':mode,'root_pid':pid,'child_pid':child,'child_first_syscall':child_entries[0]['number'],'parent_blocked_before_child_exec':parent_state,'vfork_done_observed':True,'child_exec_target_observed':True,'child_exit':29,'native_wait4_observed':True})
 for mode,value in [('invalid','5'),('fork',''),('clone','1001'),('exec','not-int'),('fork',' 5'),('fork','5 '),('fork','+'),('clone','1.0')]:
  result=subprocess.run([str(demo),mode,target,value],capture_output=True,timeout=3)
  assert result.returncode==2 and result.stdout==b'',(mode,value,result.returncode,result.stdout)
 assert os.getuid()==uid!=0
 assert (scope.read_bytes()if scope.exists()else None)==before_scope,'host ptrace policy changed'
 print('NATIVE_GCC_OWN_CHILD_FORK_EXEC_VFORK_CLONE_WAIT:'+json.dumps({'host_uid_before':uid,'host_uid_after':os.getuid(),'ptrace_policy_unchanged':True,'observations':summaries}),flush=True)
